verdict.rationale: First-party developer docs say you can subscribe to events such as `create_item` and `change_column_value`, listen for real-time events when data changes, and trigger on agent events (messaged, assigned, mentioned). They also mention connecting via a simple webhook. Missing for 10: detailed webhook documentation (payload format, signature verification, retries/delivery guarantees), an explicit statement tying event subscriptions to webhook delivery, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
